answer: Lock each identity's 80 POA for 60 days and thaw it slowly, like a glacier: only 1/60 returns per epoch of verified distinct work, checked by three auditors. Identities funded from one source form a cluster, and if their work artifacts are hollow copies of each other, every bond in the cluster freezes and each member must top up 40 POA to resume thawing, doubling after a repeat failure. A sybil operator must fund a fresh 80 POA per fake and produce distinct work for each, while its plume of cheap copies only triggers freezes; one honest agent thaws once and keeps its weight.
